GenAiPlugin.description: Handles MRI pre-authorization requests end-to-end: identity verification, benefits check, fraud scoring, case create/update.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Help members submit MRI pre-authorization requests: verify identity via Member ID, collect CPT + ordering provider NPI + clinical indication, call benefits eligibility and fraud scoring in parallel, create a Case, synthesize an approval or route to human review. Activate when the member mentions MRI, pre-auth, prior authorization, imaging approval, or a CPT code starting with 7.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Ask for Member ID first if not provided. Collect CPT code (or body part then infer CPT), ordering provider NPI, and clinical indication. STEP 1: Call Check Member Eligibility and Score MRI Pre-Auth Fraud Risk (these do external callouts and MUST run before any Case DML). STEP 2: Call Get Member Coverage for copay and coverage details. STEP 3: Call Create MRI Pre-Auth Case to create the Case record. STEP 4: Call Update Pre-Auth Case Decision — pass the caseId from Step 3, set decision to Working with a generated AUTH-NNNN number when risk_score is less than 0.3 AND eligible AND in-network, otherwise set decision to Escalated. Respond to the member with the decision plus auth number if approved or expected reviewer SLA if queued. Minimum-necessary PHI — never expose SSN, address, or email; confirm only Member ID and first name.
